findings.description: In the static wide shot the waitress stands behind the counter (server side). Between ~01:20.2 and 01:21 her white apron and legs appear below the counter edge on the customer side while her torso is still over/behind the counter top; she ends up seated on the customer side beside the man without walking around either end of the counter. She passes through the solid counter.

At 01:51 the waitress leans over the counter from the customer side beside the stools. Around 01:52 her legs stride in front of the counter face while her upper body is above/behind the counter top, and by 01:53 she is behind the counter on the server side with her back to camera. There is no gap at that point of the counter, so she walks through it.

findings.entity: seating order of man and waitress
findings.description: In the wide shot from 01:21 to 01:26 the waitress sits at the man's left, farther from camera toward the kitchen end. The 01:26.792 reverse close-up is shot from the server side, showing their faces with the booths and window wall behind them. From there she should appear screen-right of the man. Instead she appears screen-left, which puts her at his right side. The seating order is mirrored across the cut.

In the wide shot from 00:36 to 00:44.9 the man faces the camera with his jacket hem and torso inside the counter-top area, between the far edge and the chrome near edge, beside his plate. His jeans show below the near edge, in front of the counter's front panel. His body occupies the counter volume rather than sitting on a stool beside it, and he faces along the counter instead of across it, which contradicts the customer-side seating shown at 00:26 and 01:00.
